1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 6 m de altura, de tronco fino de corteza lisa y color gris castaño, hojas elípticas, flores blancas en racimos pequeños y fruto blanquecino, elíptico, carnoso y maloliente; tiene diversas aplicaciones en la medicina tradicional. RubiaceaeMorinda citrifolia.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 6 m, with a slender trunk having smooth gray-brown bark, elliptical leaves, small white flowers in clusters, and a bluish-white, elliptical, fleshy fruit with an unpleasant odor; it has various applications in traditional medicine. RubiaceaeMorinda citrifolia.
